name: Full-screen mobile menu
definition: On a phone-width page, a menu button opens a full-screen overlay with large tap targets and a close button.
bestUse: Responsive sites whose desktop navigation does not fit a small screen.

demo.how: At phone width the links collapse behind one Menu button. Opening it covers the page with large, well-spaced links and moves focus into the menu; Close or Escape returns focus to the Menu button. Tap targets stay at least 44 pixels tall. Shown inside a phone-sized frame.
